newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BOSNICH HOPING TO MAKE BELATED START TO SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOSNICH HOPING TO MAKE BELATED START TO SEASON.

text.p: Australian international goalkeeper Mark Bosnich is hoping to make his first appearance of the season on Wednesday following a catalogue of injury problems.

The Aston Villa keeper, who has not played since the final match of last season at Everton, is set to play for the reserves against Coventry City with a view to making a premier league return at Spurs on Saturday.
Bosnich suffered rib and ankle problems during the pre-season build-up, but it was the knee ligament injury he suffered two days before the start of the season which has kept him on the sidelines.
Villa physiotherapist Jim Walker said: "Mark has responded well to the treatment and at this moment in time he will be available to face Spurs."
Bosnich is keen to return to the side because his deputy, Michael Oakes, has given a series of good performances in his absence.
